## Analysissssssssssssssssss

```{r}
load("data/fusarium.Rdata")
summary(F1)

#Change the columns with charater variables to categorical variables
F1$Plant <- as.factor(F1$Plant)
F1$Variety <- as.factor(F1$Variety)
F1$Treatment <- as.factor(F1$Treatment)
F1$Block <- as.factor(F1$Block)
F1$PlantVar <- as.factor(F1$PlantVar)
F1$PlantVarTreat <- as.factor(F1$PlantVarTreat)

str(F1)


```

Plant height

```{r}


# mean plant height
by(F1$height_final, F1$PlantVarTreat, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# SD
by(F1$height_final, F1$PlantVarTreat, sd, na.rm = TRUE)


model_height <- aov(height_final ~ PlantVarTreat + Block, data = F1)

summary(model_height)


TukeyHSD(model_height)


par(mar = c(10, 4, 4, 2))

boxplot(height_final ~ PlantVarTreat, data = F1,
        las = 2,
        cex.axis = 0.7,
        ylab = "Plant height",
        xlab = "",
        main = "Plant height by variety and treatment")


plot(model_height)

```

Plant height differed among the eight plant variety-treatment combinations (ANOVA, p \< 0.001). Block had no significant effect on plant height (p= 0.248).

Total Weight

```{r}
by(F1$Total_weight, F1$PlantVarTreat, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
by(F1$Total_weight, F1$PlantVarTreat, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

boxplot(Total_weight ~ PlantVarTreat, data = F1,
        las = 2,
        cex.axis = 0.7,
        ylab = "Total weight",
        xlab = "Variety and treatment",
        main = "Total plant weight by variety and treatment")

model_weight <- aov(Total_weight ~ PlantVarTreat + Block, data = F1)

summary(model_weight)

TukeyHSD(model_weight, "PlantVarTreat")

plot(model_weight)
```

Total plant weight is different among the eight variety-treatment combinations ANOVA \< 0.001). Block had no significant effect p = 0.356.

Percentage of discoloration

```{r}
by(F1$Perc_discoloration, F1$PlantVarTreat, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
by(F1$Perc_discoloration, F1$PlantVarTreat, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
par(mar = c(10, 4, 4, 2))

boxplot(Perc_discoloration ~ PlantVarTreat, data = F1,
        las = 2,
        cex.axis = 0.7,
        ylab = "Discoloration (%)",
        xlab = "",
        main = "Percentage of discoloration by variety and treatment")
model_discoloration <- aov(Perc_discoloration ~ PlantVarTreat + Block, data = F1)

summary(model_discoloration)
TukeyHSD(model_discoloration, "PlantVarTreat")
```
